title: LiteLLM — SRE Command Center
description: The ultimate SRE dashboard for a LiteLLM proxy deployment: golden signals, spend, deployment health, budgets, backend dependency health, guardrails, and Postgres source-of-truth reporting.

panels.title: Request Rate (RPS)
panels.description: Total client-side requests/sec to the proxy

panels.title: Error Rate %
panels.description: % of client requests that failed

panels.title: In-Flight Requests
panels.description: Requests currently being processed on this pod's uvicorn workers (queue depth)

panels.title: p99 Total Latency
panels.description: 99th percentile end-to-end request latency (arrival to response)

panels.title: Cache Hit Ratio
panels.description: Share of requests served entirely from LiteLLM's own response cache

panels.title: Spend Rate ($/hr)
panels.description: Current burn rate, extrapolated to an hourly figure

panels.title: Requests / sec — Success vs Failure
panels.description: LLM deployment call rate split by outcome

panels.title: End-to-End Latency Percentiles
panels.description: litellm_request_total_latency_metric — full request lifecycle including auth, hooks, LLM call, post-processing

panels.title: Failure Rate by Exception Class
panels.description: Client-facing failures broken down by exception type — spot new error classes fast

panels.title: Latency Breakdown: Queue vs LLM API vs Overhead
panels.description: Isolate whether latency comes from auth/queueing, the upstream LLM provider, or LiteLLM's own processing

panels.title: Spend Rate by Model ($/hr)
panels.description: litellm_spend_metric — cost burn rate segmented by model

panels.title: Spend Rate by Team ($/hr)
panels.description: Cost burn rate segmented by team — attribute spend to the right budget owner

panels.title: Token Throughput by Model
panels.description: Input vs output tokens/sec, per model

panels.title: Cache Effectiveness
panels.description: LiteLLM response-cache hit/miss rate and tokens saved by caching

panels.title: Provider Prompt-Cache Efficiency
panels.description: Share of input tokens served from the upstream provider's own prompt cache (OpenAI/Anthropic/etc.)

panels.title: Reasoning Token Share of Output
panels.description: For reasoning models (o1/o3, extended thinking) — how much of output spend goes to hidden reasoning tokens

panels.title: Deployment State (0=healthy 1=partial outage 2=full outage)
panels.description: litellm_deployment_state per configured deployment — watch for non-zero values

panels.title: Deployment Success vs Failure Rate
panels.description: Per-deployment call outcomes — isolate a misbehaving upstream provider/region

panels.title: Remaining Provider Rate Limit — Requests
panels.description: x-ratelimit-remaining-requests reported by the upstream LLM API — approaching 0 means throttling risk

panels.title: Remaining Provider Rate Limit — Tokens
panels.description: x-ratelimit-remaining-tokens reported by the upstream LLM API

panels.title: Deployment Cooldowns (Load Balancer Evictions)
panels.description: Times LiteLLM's router temporarily removed a deployment from rotation due to errors

panels.title: Fallback Success vs Failure
panels.description: Primary model -> fallback model failover outcomes

panels.title: p95 LLM API Latency by Model
panels.description: Time spent purely in the upstream provider call, per model

panels.title: Requests/sec by API Key Alias
panels.description: Client traffic segmented by virtual key — spot noisy-neighbor keys

panels.title: Requests/sec by Team Alias
panels.description: Client traffic segmented by team

panels.title: Remaining Team Budget
panels.description: Budget left before a team is blocked from making requests

panels.title: Remaining API Key Budget
panels.description: Budget left before a virtual key is blocked

panels.title: Remaining Internal User Budget
panels.description: Budget left per internal user

panels.title: Hours Until Budget Reset
panels.description: Countdown to the next budget reset window per team/key

panels.title: Remaining Requests/Tokens Per Minute — Virtual Key Limits
panels.description: Only populated for virtual keys with a model-specific rate limit configured

panels.title: Dependency Error Rate
panels.description: Failed calls/sec to critical backing services — any sustained value here is an incident

panels.title: Dependency p95 Latency
panels.description: p95 round-trip time to each dependency — rising values precede timeouts and cascading latency

panels.title: DB Write Queue Depth (Spend Aggregation Buffers)
panels.description: Backpressure indicators for the async batched writer that flushes spend/usage to Postgres. Growth = DB falling behind.

panels.title: Callback Logging Failures
panels.description: Failed attempts to ship logs to S3 / Langfuse / OTel — silent data loss if ignored

panels.title: Guardrail Requests & Errors
panels.description: Guardrail invocation and error rate, per guardrail

panels.title: Guardrail p95 Latency
panels.description: p95 latency added by each guardrail check

panels.title: MCP Tool Calls
panels.description: MCP gateway tool invocation rate

panels.title: MCP Tool Call Spend
panels.description: Cost burn rate attributable to MCP tool calls

panels.title: 🗄️ Postgres — Source of Truth Spend (survives Prometheus restarts)
All-Time Total Spend
panels.description: Lifetime spend recorded in Postgres LiteLLM_SpendLogs — independent of Prometheus retention/restarts

panels.title: All-Time Total Requests
panels.description: Lifetime request count recorded in Postgres

panels.title: Spend — Last 24h
panels.description: Spend recorded in the last 24 hours per Postgres

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM("spend"), 0)::float AS "Spend (24h)" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE "startTime" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

panels.title: Requests — Last 24h
panels.description: Requests recorded in the last 24 hours per Postgres

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::float AS "Requests (24h)" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE "startTime" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

panels.title: Top Models by All-Time Spend
panels.description: Ranks models by cumulative spend recorded in Postgres — the durable source of truth for billing

targets.rawSql: SELECT "model" AS "Model", COUNT(*) AS "Requests", SUM("spend")::numeric(12,4) AS "Total Spend ($)", AVG("spend")::numeric(12,6) AS "Avg Spend / Req ($)" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" GROUP BY "model" ORDER BY SUM("spend") DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top API Keys by All-Time Spend
panels.description: Ranks virtual keys by cumulative spend

targets.rawSql: SELECT "api_key" AS "Hashed Key", COUNT(*) AS "Requests", SUM("spend")::numeric(12,4) AS "Total Spend ($)" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" GROUP BY "api_key" ORDER BY SUM("spend") DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Daily Spend Trend (Postgres, 30 days)
panels.description: Long-term spend trend, immune to Prometheus TSDB retention limits

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', "startTime") AS "time", SUM("spend")::float AS "spend" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE "startTime" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
